fato_historico: 1938: The Great Hurricane of 1938 makes landfall on Long Island in New York. The death toll is estimated at 500–700 people.
energia_do_dia: The stars suggest that powerful shifts may be approaching, much like the unexpected winds of change that once swept across the coast. While life can feel turbulent, you are finding your steady ground. It is a good time to consider how your deep roots help you weather any storm with grace and newfound, quiet wisdom.
frase_do_dia: Even the strongest winds cannot shake the spirit rooted in true inner peace.
significado_numero: Represents the potential for personal evolution and reaching new heights.
conselho: Stand tall, stay grounded, and trust in your ability to bloom through change.
